label: Synthetic benchmark trace. Not customer data.

trace.task: Document Q&A agent — answer 4 questions from a 50-page product spec document

cost_assumptions.note: Waste calculated as 18420 tokens × 4 repetitions after first occurrence at 2.5/M input tokens. First occurrence (step-3) excluded. Output tokens not counted because waste is on the input side.

findings.evidence: Detection method: block_id_and_similarity. The "Full product spec document (50 pages)" block (18,420 tokens) appears across 5 model calls. Block ID matched (full_doc_18420) and text similarity confirmed (100%). Block was reused 4 times after first occurrence (step-3).
findings.explanation: The "Full product spec document (50 pages)" block (18,420 tokens) was included in the model context 5 times but only needed once. After the first use in step-3, the remaining 4 occurrences (step-4, step-5, step-6, step-7) passed the same content again, generating an estimated $0.18 in waste. This represents approximately 13% of the total run cost.
findings.recommended_fix: Cache the content of "Full product spec document (50 pages)" after step-3. Pass a reference ID or cached summary into later steps (step-4, step-5, step-6, step-7) instead of the full block.

cost_caveat: The detected repeated-context waste represents a specific measured inefficiency. It does not represent total potential savings. A full cost comparison requires a before-and-after trace pair.
limitations: Synthetic benchmark trace, not customer data.
Cost estimates use published pricing; actual costs may differ.
RunLeak does not guarantee specific savings.
